protocol-narration-tasks.text: One commit per task, in order.

slice-narration.text: First, the narration tests, committed failing. Second, the typed tracer replaces the phase log, byte-compatible. Third, protocol events from all eight commands with four refusal kinds. Fourth, the tracing controls, the indented text renderer and the JSON renderer. Fifth, Demo 1 runs with trace how, and the node guide documents the flags.

slice-socket-sink.text: A contra-tracer-contrib pull request adds the socket sink, the pin is bumped, trace-to socket is accepted, and a test reads the socket and asserts the typed events.
